name: Mass Dispel
description: Dispels magic in a 15 yard radius, removing all harmful Magic from 5 friendly targets and 1 beneficial Magic effect from 5 enemy targets. Potent enough to remove Magic that is normally undispellable.

name: Power Infusion
description: Infuses the target with power for 15 sec, increasing haste by 20%.\n\nCan only be cast on players.

name: Voidform
description:
Bombards your target with a Void Volley and twists your Shadowform with void magic, increasing your spell damage by 20% for 20 sec. 

This spell is replaced with Void Volley while Voidform is active.

 Void Volley
Releases a volley of pure void energy, firing 10 bolts at your target and 1 bolt at all enemies within 10 yards of your target for 402 Shadow damage.

Generates 10 Insanity.

name: Desperate Prayer
description: Increases maximum health by 25% for 10 sec, and instantly heals you for that amount.

name: Halo
description: Creates a ring of Shadow energy around you that quickly expands to a 40 yd radius, healing allies for 603 and dealing 560 Shadow damage to enemies. Healing reduced beyond 6 targets.

name: Psychic Scream
description: Lets out a psychic scream, causing all enemies within 8 yards to flee, disorienting them for 8 sec. Damage may interrupt the effect.

name: Fade
description: Fade out, removing all your threat and reducing enemies' detection range against you for 10 sec.

name: Void Torrent
description:
Channel a torrent of void energy into the target, dealing 3,930 Shadow damage over 3 sec and tearing open an Entropic Rift.

 Entropic Rift
Mind Blast tears open an Entropic Rift that follows the enemy for 8 sec. Enemies caught in its path suffer 228 Shadow damage every 0.9 sec while within its reach.

Generates 24 Insanity over the duration.

name: Purify Disease
description: Removes all Disease effects from a friendly target.

name: Leap of Faith
description: Pulls the spirit of a party or raid member, instantly moving them directly in front of you.

name: Angelic Feather
description: Places a feather at the target location, granting the first ally to walk through it 40% increased movement speed for 5 sec. Only 3 feathers can be placed at one time.

name: Dispel Magic
description: Dispels Magic on the enemy target, removing 1 beneficial Magic effect.

name: Holy Nova
description: An explosion of holy light around you deals up to 156 Holy damage to enemies and up to 117 healing to allies within 12 yds, reduced if there are more than 5 targets.

name: Mind Blast
description: Blast the target's mind for 301 Shadow damage. Costs a high amount of mana.

name: Shackle Horror
description: Shackles an aberration or undead enemy for 50 sec, preventing all actions and movement. Damage will cancel the effect. Limit 1.

name: Shadow Word: Death
description: A word of dark binding that inflicts 328 Shadow damage to your target. If your target is not killed by Shadow Word: Death, you take backlash damage equal to 5% of your maximum health.\n\nDamage increased by 150% to targets below 20% health.

name: Shadow Word: Madness
description: A word of madness haunts the target's mind, dealing 864 Shadow damage instantly plus an additional 2,905 Shadow damage over 6 sec. Heals you for 30% of damage dealt.\n\nWhen reapplied to a target, all remaining damage is added to the new effect.

name: Shadowfiend
description:
Shadow Word: Death has a 40% chance to summon a Shadowfiend for 5 sec when damaging targets below 20% health.

 Shadowfiend
Summons a Shadowfiend to attack your target for 5 sec.

Generates 0.5% mana each time the Shadowfiend attacks.

name: Tentacle Slam
description:
Summons a massive shadowy appendage to slam the ground, dealing 260 Shadow damage in front of you and 8 yds around your target.

Applies Vampiric Touch to up to 6 enemies, prioritizing ones without Vampiric Touch.

Generates 6 Insanity.

name: Dominate Mind
description: Controls a mind up to 1 level above yours for 30 sec while still controlling your own mind. Does not work versus Demonic, Mechanical, or Undead beings or players. This spell shares diminishing returns with other disorienting effects.

name: Mind Control
description: Controls a mind up to 1 level above yours for 30 sec. Does not work versus Demonic, Undead, or Mechanical beings. Shares diminishing returns with other disorienting effects.

name: Dispersion
description:
Disperse into pure shadow energy, reducing all damage taken by 75% for 6 sec and healing you for 25% of your maximum health over its duration, but you are unable to attack or cast spells.

Increases movement speed by 50% and makes you immune to all movement impairing effects.

Castable while stunned, feared, or silenced.

name: Spirit of Redemption
description: The Priest becomes the Spirit of Redemption for 6 sec. The Spirit of Redemption cannot move, attack, be attacked or targeted by any spells or effects. While in this form the Priest can cast any healing spell free of cost.

name: Vampiric Embrace
description: Fills you with the embrace of Shadow energy for 12 sec, causing you to heal a nearby ally for 40% of any single-target Shadow spell damage you deal.

name: Ascension
description: Ascend into the air, keeping you out of harm's way. Lasts 20 sec. Can only be used while in Ashran.

name: Light's Wrath
description: Draws upon the power of Light's Wrath, dealing 665 Radiant damage to the target, increased by 10% per ally affected by your Atonement.

name: Silence
description: Silences the target, preventing them from casting spells for 5 sec. Against non-players, also interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 4 sec.

name: Power Word: Shield
description: Shields an ally for 15 sec, absorbing 1,747 damage.

name: Mind Soothe
description: Soothes enemies in the target area, reducing the range at which they will detect you by 10 yards. Only affects Humanoid and Dragonkin targets. Does not cause threat. Lasts 20 sec.

name: Echo of Light
description: Heals every 2 sec for 4 sec.

name: Flash Heal
description: A fast spell that heals an ally for 2,573.

name: Levitate
description: Levitates a party or raid member for 10 min, floating a few feet above the ground, granting slow fall, and allowing travel over water.

name: Light of T'uure
description: Applies Light of the Naaru to the target, healing for 380 and increasing your healing done to that target by 25% for 10 sec.

name: Mind Flay
description: Assaults the target's mind with Shadow energy, causing 2,740 Shadow damage over 4.0 sec and slowing their movement speed by 50%.\n\nGenerates 18 Insanity over the duration.

name: Mind Vision
description: Allows the caster to see through the target's eyes for 1 min. Will not work if the target is in another instance or on another continent.

name: Power Word: Fortitude
description: Infuses the target with vitality, increasing their Stamina by 5% for 1 hour.\n\nIf the target is in your party or raid, all party and raid members will be affected.

name: Resurrection
description: Brings a dead ally back to life with 35% health and mana. Cannot be cast when in combat.

name: Shadow Word: Pain
description: A word of darkness that causes 64 Shadow damage instantly, and an additional 424 Shadow damage over 16 sec.

name: Shadowform
description: Assume a Shadowform, increasing your spell damage dealt by 10%.

name: Single-Button Assistant
description: Casts damaging abilities for use in combat, rotating through them based on priority.\n\nThe global cooldown of abilities used through the Single-Button Assistant is 25% longer.

name: Smite
description: Smites an enemy for 372 Holy damage.

name: Vampiric Touch
description: A touch of darkness that causes 1,987 Shadow damage over 21 sec, and heals you for 30% of damage dealt. If Vampiric Touch is dispelled, the dispeller flees in Horror for 3 sec.\n\nGenerates 4 Insanity.

name: Mindgames
description: Assault an enemy's mind, dealing 1,139 Shadow damage and briefly reversing their perception of reality.\n\nFor 7 sec, the next 3,990 damage they deal will heal their target, and the next 3,990 healing they deal will damage their target.

name: Psyfiend
description:
Summons a Psyfiend with 1,222 health for 12 sec beside you to attack the target at range with Psyflay.

 Psyflay
Deals up to 1% of the target's total health in Shadow damage every 0.9 sec. Also slows their movement speed by 50% and reduces healing received by 50%.

name: Absolute Faith
description: Leap of Faith also pulls the spirit of the 3 furthest allies within 40 yards and shields you and the affected allies for 2,851.

name: Cascading Horrors
description: Void Eruption sends out slow-moving bolts of Shadow energy at random locations every 0.5 sec for 3 sec, dealing 294 Shadow damage to all targets within 8 yds, and causing them to flee in Horror for 2 sec.

name: Driven to Madness
description: While Voidform is not active, being attacked will reduce the cooldown of Voidform by 3 sec.

name: Improved Mass Dispel
description: Reduces the cooldown of Mass Dispel by 60 sec.

name: Mind Trauma
description: Siphon haste from enemies, stealing 2% haste per stack of Mind Trauma, stacking up to 9 times. Fully channeled Mind Flays grant 1 stack of Mind Trauma and fully channeled Void Torrents grant 3 stacks of Mind Trauma. Lasts 15 sec.\n\nYou can only gain 3 stacks of Mind Trauma from a single enemy.

name: Phase Shift
description: Step into the shadows when you cast Fade, avoiding all attacks and spells for 1 sec.\n\nInterrupt effects are not affected by Phase Shift.

name: Psychic Shroud
description: When your Psychic Scream affects 1 or more players, the next crowd control effect against you is prevented. Lasts 6 sec.

name: Ancient Madness
description: Casting Shadow Word: Madness increases the duration of Voidform by 3.0 sec.\n\nEach time this occurs during Voidform, its effectiveness is reduced by 25%.

name: Angel's Mercy
description: Reduces the cooldown of Desperate Prayer by 20 sec.

name: Angelic Bulwark
description: When an attack brings you below 30% health, you gain an absorption shield equal to 25% of your maximum health for 20 sec. Cannot occur more than once every 90 sec.

name: Auspicious Spirits
description: Your Shadowy Apparitions deal 15% increased damage and have a chance to generate 1 Insanity.

name: Benevolence
description: Increases the healing of your spells by 3%.

name: Binding Heals
description: 20% of Flash Heal healing on other targets also heals you.

name: Body and Soul
description: Power Word: Shield and Leap of Faith increase your target's movement speed by 40% for 3 sec.

name: Collapsing Void
description: Each time Penance damages or heals, Entropic Rift is empowered, increasing its damage and size by 10%.\n\nAfter Entropic Rift ends it collapses, dealing 1,672 Shadow damage split amongst enemy targets within 15 yds.

name: Crushing Void
description: Tentacle Slam deals 50% increased damage and Void Volley deals 15% increased damage.\n\nWhen Voidform ends, you can cast Void Volley 1 additional time within 30 sec.

name: Dark Energy
description: While Entropic Rift is active, you move 20% faster.

name: Dark Enlightenment
description: Increases your haste by 3%.

name: Dark Evangelism
description: Increases your periodic spell damage by 6%.

name: Dark Thoughts
description: Increases the chance for Shadowy Insight to occur by 25%. When consuming Shadowy Insight, Mind Blast generates 1 additional Insanity.

name: Darkening Horizon
description: Void Blast increases the duration of Entropic Rift by 1.0 sec, up to a maximum of 3 sec.

name: Death and Madness
description: If a target dies within 7 sec after being struck by Shadow Word: Death, generate 8 Insanity.\n\nWhen Shadow Word: Death fails to kill a target below 20% health, its cooldown is reset. Cannot occur more than once every 10 sec.

name: Death's Torment
description: Shadow Word: Death deals damage 2 additional times at 15% effectiveness.

name: Deathspeaker
description: Shadow Word: Death damage increased by 25%.\n\nShadow Word: Death gains its damage and talent bonuses against targets below 35% health instead of 20%.

name: Descending Darkness
description: Increases Tentacle Slam damage by 300%.

name: Devour Matter
description: Shadow Word: Death consumes absorb shields from your target, dealing 971 extra damage to them and granting you 1% mana if a shield was present.

name: Distorted Reality
description: Increases the damage of Shadow Word: Madness by 20% and causes it to deal its damage over 12 sec, but increases its Insanity cost by 5.

name: Divine Halo
description: Halo now centers around you and returns to you after it reaches its maximum distance, healing allies and damaging enemies each time it passes through them.

name: Embrace the Shadow
description: You absorb 3% of all magic damage taken. Absorbing Shadow damage heals you for 100% of the amount absorbed.

name: Empowered Surges
description: Your spells affected by Surge of Light heal for 5% more while Surge of Light is active.

name: Energy Compression
description: Halo damage and healing is increased by 30%.

name: Energy Conservation
description: Power Surge lasts an additional 5 sec.

name: Energy Cycle
description: Casting Mind Flay: Insanity has a 100% chance to conjure Shadowy Apparitions.

name: Entropic Rift
description: Mind Blast tears open an Entropic Rift that follows the enemy for 8 sec. Enemies caught in its path suffer 223 Shadow damage every 0.9 sec while within its reach.

name: Everlasting Light
description: Surge of Light occurs up to 50% more often based on your missing mana.

name: False Autonomy
description: Increases the duration of Mind Control and Dominate Mind against enemy creatures by 15 sec.

name: Focused Outburst
description: Void Volley damage increased by 15% and its cooldown is reduced by 4 sec.

name: Focused Power
description: Increases the damage of your spells by 3%.

name: Haunting Shadows
description: Shadowy Apparition damage increased by 10%.\n\nWhen Shadowy Apparitions deal damage, they extend the duration of your Shadow Word: Pain and Vampiric Touch on the target by 1.0 sec.

name: Heightened Alteration
description: Increases the duration of Dispersion by 2 sec.

name: Idol of C'Thun
description:
Mind Flay has a chance to spawn a Void Tendril that channels Mind Flay or Void Lasher that channels Mind Sear at your target.

 Mind Flay
Assaults the target's mind with Shadow energy, causing 1,228 Shadow damage over 10 sec and slowing their movement speed by 30%.

Generates 5 Insanity over the duration.

 Mind Sear
Corrosive shadow energy radiates from the target, dealing 826 Shadow damage over 10 sec to all enemies within 10 yards of the target. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.

Generates 5 Insanity over the duration.

name: Idol of N'Zoth
description:
You create Horrific Visions when casting harmful spells on enemies.

At 50 stacks of Horrific Visions, your target sees a nightmare, dealing 691 Shadow damage and granting you 4 Insanity over 3 sec.

At 100 stacks, your target witnesses a vision of N'Zoth, dealing 2,618 Shadow damage and granting you 12 Insanity over 3 sec.

name: Idol of Y'Shaarj
description: While Shadowfiend, Mindbender, or Voidwraith are active, your haste is increased by 10%.

name: Idol of Yogg-Saron
description:
After conjuring Shadowy Apparitions, gain a stack of Idol of Yogg-Saron. At 20 stacks, you summon a Thing from Beyond that casts Void Spike at nearby enemies for 20 sec.

 Void Spike
Hurls a bolt of dark magic, dealing 356 Shadow damage and 186 Shadow damage to all enemies within 10 yards of the target. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.

name: Improved Fade
description: Reduces the cooldown of Fade by 5 sec.

name: Improved Flash Heal
description: Increases healing done by Flash Heal by 15%.

name: Improved Voidform
description: Voidform generates 60 Insanity and increases your spell damage by an additonal 5%.

name: Incessant Screams
description: Psychic Scream creates an image of you at your location. After 4 sec, the image will let out a Psychic Scream.

name: Inescapable Torment
description: Mind Blast and Shadow Word: Death cause your Shadowfiend, Mindbender, and Voidwraith to teleport behind your target, slashing up to 5 nearby enemies for 319 Shadow damage and extending their durations by 0.7 sec.

name: Inner Quietus
description: Power Word: Shield absorbs 20% additional damage.

name: Insidious Ire
description: While you have Shadow Word: Pain, Shadow Word: Madness, and Vampiric Touch active on the same target, your Mind Blast, Void Torrent, Mind Flay, and Void Volley deal 20% more damage.

name: Inspiration
description: Reduces your target's physical damage taken by 5% for 15 sec after a critical heal with Flash Heal or Penance.

name: Instilled Doubt
description: Increases the critical strike chance of Vampiric Touch and Shadow Word: Pain by 8% and their critical strike damage by 20%.

name: Intangibility
description: Dispersion heals you for an additional 25% of your maximum health over its duration and its cooldown is reduced by 30 sec.

name: Invoked Nightmare
description: Shadow Word: Pain deals 150% increased damage.

name: Light's Inspiration
description: Increases the maximum health gained from Desperate Prayer by 10%.

name: Lightburst
description: Increases the damage of Holy Nova by 400%, its healing by 500%, and its cooldown by 30 sec.

name: Maddening Tentacles
description: Tentacle Slam afflicts your target with Shadow Word: Madness at 25% effectiveness.

name: Maddening Touch
description: Vampiric Touch deals 20% additional damage and has a chance to generate 1 Insanity each time it deals damage.

name: Madness Weaving
description: The damage bonus from your Mastery: Shadow Weaving gains 50% additional benefit from Shadow Word: Madness.

name: Manifested Power
description:
Creating a Halo grants Surge of Light.

 Surge of Light
Your healing spells and Smite have a 8% chance to make your next Flash Heal instant and cost 50% less mana. Stacks to 2.

name: Mastermind
description: Increases the critical strike chance of Mind Blast, Mind Flay, and Shadow Word: Death by 4% and increases their critical strike damage by 20%.

name: Mental Agility
description: Reduces the mana cost of Purify and Mass Dispel by 50% and Dispel Magic by 10%.

name: Mental Decay
description: Increases the damage of Mind Flay by 25%.

name: Mental Fortitude
description: Healing from Vampiric Touch and Shadow Word: Madness when you are at maximum health will shield you for the same amount. The shield cannot exceed 10% of your maximum health.

name: Mind Devourer
description: Mind Blast has a 8% chance to make your next Shadow Word: Madness cost no Insanity and deal 20% additional damage.

name: Mind's Eye
description: Reduces the Insanity cost of Shadow Word: Madness by 5.

name: Mindbender
description:
Casting Voidform summons a Mindbender for 10 sec.

 Mindbender
Summons a shadowy fiend to attack your target.

Generates 1 Insanity each time the Mindbender attacks.

name: Mindpierce
description: Increases the damage of Smite by 15%.

name: Misery
description: Vampiric Touch also applies Shadow Word: Pain to the target. Shadow Word: Pain lasts an additional 5 sec.

name: Move with Grace
description: Reduces the cooldown of Leap of Faith by 30 sec.

name: No Escape
description: Entropic Rift slows enemies by up to 70%, increased the closer they are to its center.

name: Overwhelming Shadows
description: Mind Blast deals 100% increased damage.

name: Painful Invocation
description: Increases the damage of Shadow Word: Pain by 10%.

name: Perfected Form
description: Your damage dealt is increased by 5% while Voidform is active.

name: Petrifying Scream
description: Psychic Scream causes enemies to tremble in place instead of fleeing in fear.

name: Phantasm
description: Activating Fade removes all snare effects.

name: Phantom Menace
description: Increases the critical strike chance of Shadowy Apparitions by 10% and their critical strike damage by 40%.

name: Phantom Reach
description: Increases the range of most spells by 15%.

name: Power Surge
description: Casting Halo also causes you to create a Halo around you at 100% effectiveness every 5 sec for 10 sec.

name: Protective Light
description: Casting Flash Heal on yourself reduces all damage you take by 10% for 10 sec.

name: Psychic Link
description: Your direct damage spells inflict 25% of their damage on all other targets afflicted by your Vampiric Touch within 40 yards.\n\nDoes not apply to damage from Shadowy Apparitions, Shadow Word: Pain, and Vampiric Touch.

name: Psychic Voice
description: Reduces the cooldown of Psychic Scream by 10 sec.

name: Quickened Pulse
description: Shadow Word: Pain and Entropic Rift deal damage 25% more often.

name: Realized Potential
description: Shadow Word: Death damage increased by 25% and its cooldown is reduced by 3 sec.

name: Resonant Energy
description: Allies healed by your Halo receive 2% increased healing from you for 8 sec, stacking up to 5 times.

name: Sanguine Teachings
description: Increases your Leech by 2%.

name: Screams of the Void
description: Shadow Word: Madness causes your Shadow Word: Pain and Vampiric Touch to deal damage 40% faster on all targets for 3 sec.

name: Shadowy Apparitions
description: Shadow Word: Madness conjures Shadowy Apparitions that float towards all targets afflicted by your Vampiric Touch for 320 Shadow damage.

name: Shadowy Insight
description: Shadow Word: Pain periodic damage has a chance to cause your next Mind Blast to be instant and ignore its cooldown.

name: Shattered Psyche
description: Mind Flay damage increases the critical strike chance of Mind Blast by 8%, stacking up to 12 times.\n\nLasts 10 sec.

name: Sheer Terror
description: Increases the amount of damage required to break your Psychic Scream by 25%.

name: Shock Pulse
description: Halo damage reduces enemy movement speed by 5% for 5 sec, stacking up to 5 times.

name: Spectral Horrors
description: Shadow Apparitions deal 30% increased damage to targets affected by your Shadow Word: Madness.

name: Spectral Illusion
description: Fade creates an illusion of you for 4 sec, tricking enemies to attack it instead.

name: Spell Warding
description: Reduces all magic damage taken by 3%.

name: Spiritual Guidance
description: Increases your Intellect by 3%.

name: Spiritwell
description: Increases Shadowy Apparition damage by 10%.

name: Strength of Resolve
description: Increases your Stamina by 6%.

name: Subservient Shadows
description: Summoned minions last 20% longer and deal an additional 15% damage.

name: Surge of Insanity
description: Mind Flay damage increased by 15% and Insanity generation increased by 30%.

name: Surge of Light
description: Your healing spells and Smite have a 8% chance to make your next Flash Heal instant and cost 50% less mana. Stacks to 2.

name: Sustained Potency
description: Creating a Halo extends the duration of Voidform by 1 sec. If Voidform is not active, up to 6 seconds is stored.\n\nWhile out of combat or affected by a loss of control effect, the duration of Voidform is paused for up to 20 sec.

name: Thought Harvester
description: Mind Blast gains an additional charge.

name: Tithe Evasion
description: Shadow Word: Death deals 50% less damage to you.

name: Tormented Spirits
description: Your Shadow Word: Pain damage has a chance to create Shadowy Apparitions that float towards all targets afflicted by your Vampiric Touch. \n\nCritical strikes increase the chance by 100%.

name: Tormenting Whispers
description: Increases Shadow Word: Madness damage by 15%.

name: Touch of the Void
description: Voidheart now persists for 8 sec after Entropic Rift ends.

name: Translucent Image
description: Fade reduces damage you take by 10%.

name: Twin Disciplines
description: Increases the damage and healing of your Holy and Shadow spells by 2%.

name: Twins of the Sun Priestess
description: Power Infusion also grants you its effect at 100% value when used on an ally. \n\nIf no ally is targeted, it will grant its effect at 100% value to a nearby ally, preferring damage dealers.

name: Twist of Fate
description: After damaging or healing a target below 35% health, gain 5% increased damage and healing for 8 sec.

name: Unwavering Will
description: While above 75% health, the cast time of your Flash Heal, Prayer of Healing, and Smite are reduced by 5%.

name: Void Apparitions
description: When an effect from an Idol is activated, conjure Shadowy Apparitions.

name: Void Blast
description:
Entropic Rift upgrades Smite into Void Blast while it is active.

Void Blast:
Sends a blast of cosmic void energy at the enemy, causing 567 Shadow damage.

name: Void Empowerment
description: Summoning an Entropic Rift extends the duration of your 5 shortest Atonements by 1 sec.

name: Void Infusion
description: While Entropic Rift is active, Atonement healing with Void Blast and Penance is 50% more effective.

name: Void Leech
description: Every 3 sec siphon an amount equal to 4% of your health from an ally within 40 yds if they are higher health than you.

name: Void Tendrils
description: Call shadowy tendrils to constrict enemies when Psychic Scream ends, rooting them in place for 4 sec.

name: Voidheart
description: While Entropic Rift is active, your Atonement healing is increased by 20%.

name: Voidtouched
description: Increases your Shadow Word: Madness damage by 6% and increases your maximum Insanity by 50.

name: Voidwraith
description:
When Entropic Rift ends, a Voidwraith is summoned from the collapsed rift for 5 sec.

Voidwraith
Summon a Voidwraith that casts Void Flay from afar. Void Flay deals bonus damage to high health enemies, up to a maximum of 50% if they are full health.

Generates 0.5% Mana each time the Voidwraith attacks.

name: Word of Supremacy
description: Power Word: Fortitude grants you an additional 5% stamina.

name: Focused Will
description: Melee attacks against you cause you to gain Focused Will, reducing damage you take by 15% for 8 sec, stacking up to 1 times.

name: Horrific Visions
description:
You create Horrific Visions when casting harmful spells on enemies.

At $s1 stacks of Horrific Visions, your target sees a nightmare, dealing $1243105s1 Shadow damage and granting you ${$1243113o1/100} Insanity over $1243113s2 sec.

At $s2 stacks, your target witnesses a vision of N'Zoth, dealing $1243106s1 Shadow damage and granting you ${$1243114o1/100} Insanity over $1243114s2 sec.

description:
